name: Red Dragon Wyrmling

source.note: The 2024 Red Dragon Wyrmling, read twice from aidedd.org's Monster Manual (2024) page for it (AC 17, 75 HP, Rend +6 for 1d10+4 Slashing plus 1d6 Fire, Fire Breath 15-ft cone, DC 13 Dex, 7d6 Fire). Castle Ravenloft's entry (K7) has small dragon statues that wake when the party tries to leave; Veeder's survey calls them child-sized dragons of Curse of Strahd, and the Master Quest and Reloaded adaptations make them red dragon wyrmlings (the book's own page was not open, so the colour is theirs and the count and Hit Points are ours, tuned per fight).

actions.name: Rend
actions.summary: Claws and teeth that leave the wound burning.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a 15-ft cone of fire; DC 13 Dex save, 7d6 Fire, half damage on a success.
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

summary: A child-sized dragon that was a statue until you tried to leave: two rending attacks and a gout of flame.
